source.title: LR-0002: CHIP-8 Codebase Audit & Architecture Baseline

cards.question: Which modules already exist in the CHIP-8 C17 emulator?
cards.answer: Modular headers and sources for memory, registers, stack, keyboard, screen, and an SDL2 event loop.

cards.question: Which core data structures are already laid out?
cards.answer: Memory, Registers, Stack, Screen, Keyboard, and Chip8.

cards.question: Where should CHIP-8 ROMs be loaded, and what check is required?
cards.answer: Load ROMs at `0x200` with boundary checks.

cards.question: How will opcodes be fetched and decoded?
cards.answer: As 16-bit big-endian values, then decoded with bitwise instruction decoding.
